P04.why_not_done: The source archive is here, but we have not completed assay eligibility review or built an isolated test-input/reference manifest and frozen local scalar run for this task. Even the expected 520-row test count has only been taken from the publisher loader, not verified by an LMDB inventory.
P04.finish_requirement: Complete the assay eligibility decision; inventory the native test cohort; freeze isolated inputs/references, scalar delivery checks and native scoring; only then run and score the declared permitted cohort.
P04.next_deliverable: A documented eligibility disposition and exact LMDB test-cohort inventory; if eligible, a frozen isolated task input/reference manifest.

P05.why_not_done: The exact FLIP two_vs_many files and the 50,776-row test inventory are already available. We have not completed the capsid-assay eligibility review or turned that split into separated solver inputs/targets, a frozen scalar configuration and a task-specific delivery check.
P05.finish_requirement: Complete assay eligibility review, then freeze the known native test split into isolated inputs/references and a validated local scalar run; preserve any resulting holds.
P05.next_deliverable: A source-grounded capsid-assay eligibility disposition and, if eligible, the complete frozen 50776-row native test input/reference split.

P17.why_not_done: All 217 ProteinGym assay CSVs are in the acquired archive, but no reviewed allowed-assay roster or release-specific full prediction/scoring run has been frozen. The corpus includes held assays. A GFP-only preparation prototype exists, but it is not a completed all-assay pipeline and its expected prepared-data directory is absent in this workspace.
P17.finish_requirement: Define and review the permitted assay roster, prepare version-matched input/reference manifests, validate the prediction/scoring interface, then run and score the declared scope without hidden exclusions.
P17.next_deliverable: A reviewed permitted-assay roster and a hash-pinned preparation/scoring contract for an explicitly declared subset, without reviving held or interrupted scope.

P19.why_not_done: The 34-assay reviewed subset, runner and scorer are prepared, 37 software checks passed, and the three synthetic prompts passed actual CPU tokenizer checks. We have not admitted the P19 runner to a frozen live runtime or made its three actual synthetic model-delivery calls. The in-memory 3/3 fixture result is not that live gate.
P19.finish_requirement: Adopt the already prepared P19 runtime entry prospectively; pass three actual synthetic model-delivery cases and seal them; then execute and score the separate 34-assay reviewed condition. Full native coverage separately needs review of 77 assays and resolution of 12 holds.
P19.next_deliverable: Adopt a prospective frozen P19 runtime admission and produce a real, sealed 3/3 synthetic delivery pass.

P21.why_not_done: The 67 native T3 target tables and source builders are available. We have not reviewed the real assay scopes or built model inputs containing each supplied measured anchor and candidate list while excluding hidden candidate measurements. No real task-specific ranking delivery panel or frozen local run is ready.
P21.finish_requirement: Review real T3 assay scopes, prepare isolated anchor/candidate input manifests, verify complete-ranking output delivery and freeze the local run/scorer before execution.
P21.next_deliverable: One reviewed real T3 input manifest with a reference-isolation audit and a synthetic full-ranking completeness test bound to its exact candidate contract.

P22.why_not_done: All 29 native T4 target/context pairs and source builders are available. We have not reviewed the real assay scopes or separated the supplied single-mutant measurements, which are allowed inputs, from the multi-mutant target measurements, which must stay scorer-only. No real-case ranking run or delivery gate has been prepared.
P22.finish_requirement: Review real T4 assay scopes, separate supplied component measurements from hidden combination targets, validate complete-ranking delivery and freeze the local run/scorer before execution.
P22.next_deliverable: One reviewed real T4 input manifest with a field-isolation audit and a synthetic full-ranking completeness test bound to the exact candidate contract.

P27.why_not_done: Exact native replication lacks the author's fixed NCBI test accession list, absolute temporal cutoff and matching annotation/reference snapshot. Those were not found in the audited releases. The user has already allowed a labelled available alternative, but we have not selected and frozen its cohort and reference preprocessing or implemented its run.
P27.finish_requirement: For native replication obtain the original dated accession/cohort and annotation/reference artifacts. Otherwise finish a clearly named available adaptation with a fixed cohort, isolated references, declared differences and validated scoring; existing user authority permits that adaptation.
P27.next_deliverable: A frozen, source-grounded available-adaptation specification identifying exact cohort/reference preprocessing and material differences; retain native replication as unavailable.

P34.why_not_done: The encoder and five existing evaluator heads are already available. We have not implemented the Qwen proposal adapter or the iterative optimization/scoring worker; the October 20 task directory still contains only its assignment record. The remaining work is agent implementation.
P34.finish_requirement: Implement and validate a separately named proposal/optimization condition using the existing heads, preserve held landscapes and all failures, then run the declared permitted cases and aggregate its frozen metrics without training new heads.
P34.next_deliverable: A tested proposal adapter and worker that binds the available encoder/heads to a frozen optimization and scoring contract.

P35.why_not_done: The checkpoint loads on CPU and 27 tests passed, but we have not produced the final retained/rejected corpus-ID inventory and order or run retrieval. The release supplies five example queries without relevance gold or an aggregate accuracy definition; producing rankings is possible, but reporting a native numeric accuracy is not currently defined.
P35.finish_requirement: Finish the declared corpus projection/retention audit and input scope review, validate the existing-checkpoint runtime, run the five fixed queries and archive complete scores/top20 rankings. A numeric benchmark accuracy additionally requires a source-grounded relevance/aggregation contract that is not in the release; do not invent it.
P35.next_deliverable: Run the existing dormant CPU corpus projector and produce a hash-pinned retained/rejected ID and ordering manifest.

Combined learned-weight binding, an actual folding delivery check, and the reviewed frozen benchmark handoff are still unperformed. Exact native sampling/clustering remains unrecovered.
P37.finish_requirement: Complete strict combined weight binding with checked memory headroom, validate actual folding delivery and permissible scope, then execute and score the frozen released-code adaptation while preserving native-protocol differences.
P37.next_deliverable: A strict combined model/weight-load receipt and an independent folding-delivery validation in an adequately sized isolated runtime.

P38.finish_requirement: Assemble and validate the isolated NetSolP and thermal encoder/head runtimes, freeze separate generation/delivery conditions, review their permissible scope, pass actual delivery gates and run the complete declared proxy evaluations without new head training.
P38.next_deliverable: Working isolated NetSolP and thermal evaluator backends with recorded synthetic input/output validation.

P39.why_not_done: Structural dependencies are acquired, but we have not written a prospective case-study configuration or a complex-predictor worker. The exact author cohort, selection procedure and scoring contract are unreleased, so there is no source-defined full-cohort binding accuracy to reproduce.
P39.finish_requirement: Freeze a reviewed, explicitly qualified case-study cohort and selection/evaluation contract, implement and validate its existing-predictor worker, then report the resulting structural/proxy evidence without inventing biological binding accuracy.
P39.next_deliverable: A concrete adaptation specification plus a tested complex-predictor worker interface; keep exact native replication marked unavailable.

P40.why_not_done: All 60 current-structure mappings/masks and 13 synthetic checks are complete. We have not reviewed case eligibility or implemented the geometry-aware solver adapter that removes target residue identities and target coordinates. Available current structures are a qualified condition, not certified historical processed bytes.
P40.finish_requirement: Complete independent permitted-case review and target-isolated geometric input packaging, validate the solver/evaluator contract, then run and score the declared current-structure adaptation.
P40.next_deliverable: A reviewed case roster and tested solver input adapter that preserves permitted geometry without exposing target residues or coordinates.

P41.why_not_done: All 16 checkpoint files, five vendor dependencies and 83 fixtures are acquired. We have not implemented a task-specific mask/preprocessing/scoring worker; the task directory still contains only its assignment record. The exact paper holdout cohort, canonical masks and aggregation are unreleased in inspected sources, while a labelled released-demo adaptation remains possible.
P41.finish_requirement: Build and validate the released-demo runtime with explicit input masks, target isolation and scoring, review its case scope and report the qualified adaptation. Exact native reproduction separately needs the unreleased cohort/mask/aggregation artifacts.
P41.next_deliverable: A tested mask/preprocessing/scorer adapter for the available released demonstrations, with its exact condition differences documented.

V07.why_not_done: All 8,000 images and 2,215 prepared cases are available, and materialization finished at 2:22 AM. We have not completed question/full-deck content review, actual 20-image processor expansion/context-fit testing or model delivery checks. The 1:40 AM readiness claim that copying was still running is stale.
V07.finish_requirement: Complete permitted case/deck review, verify actual processor expansion and context/output fit for all20pages, then pass the independent delivery gate and execute/score the explicitly mixed-image-source adaptation.
V07.next_deliverable: A case-review disposition file and a real processor/context-fit receipt, followed by the existing synthetic delivery panel.
